trust_decision.summary: How long the first token of a normproto line in a .traineddata file can be is trusted when it is extracted into the fixed stack buffer unichar[2*UNICHAR_LEN+1] in Classify::ReadNormProtos; the fix adds a std::setw width limit.

landing_point.why: The advisory names ReadNormProtos, and the only unbounded char* extraction in it is on this line.

fix_sites.entry_point: Legacy-engine init (Classify::InitAdaptiveClassifier loads the TESSDATA_NORMPROTO component of a .traineddata file; reached from TessBaseAPI::Init / tesseract CLI with a legacy OEM)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route. The nearby unbounded %s reads (featdefs.cpp, commontraining.cpp, mastertrainer.cpp) only parse training-tool input files, not .traineddata, so a solver would rightly call them out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A unichar token of exactly 2*UNICHAR_LEN bytes and well-formed 'a 0' lines must still parse, and a bad line must be skipped (continue) without rejecting the whole component. An over-broad fix that returns nullptr or aborts on an overlong line breaks the fix's own tests (they require a non-null NormProtos).

O6_input_shapes: overlong first token (up to 99 chars, the FGets line limit)
token of exactly 2*UNICHAR_LEN chars (must be kept)

O7_producer.where: src/training/cntraining.cpp:225 (WriteNormProtos writes the label with %s, no length cap)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ReadNewCutoffs (pffmtable component, loaded right before normproto) extracts the class token with the same istringstream pattern; switching std::string Class to a fixed char buffer would plant a twin.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same author style and the same FGets(line,100) + stream >> X >> int loop as ReadNormProtos; the two are loaded back to back in src/classify/adaptmatch.cpp:556-560.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ReadPrototype (called for every normproto entry) uses sscanf with %79s into char[80]; dropping the width (plain %s) would plant a how-type sibling one call deeper in another file.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The width here is a separate macro string QUOTED_TOKENSIZE (clusttool.cpp:30) that has to be kept in step with TOKENSIZE by hand, a classic drift point.

O9_family: memory-safety: stack buffer overflow from unbounded string extraction while parsing a model file (CWE-121)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake or autotools, C++17 compiler, leptonica; googletest for unittest/ (legacy tests list)
O10_build.project_tests: No normproto test at the pinned commit; the fix adds unittest/normproto_test.cc (fix.diff:64-180), registered in Makefile.am and in the LEGACY_TESTS list of unittest/CMakeLists.txt.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add std::setw(sizeof(unichar)) to the extraction, or switch unichar to std::string; both are correct, which is why the task is easy.

out_of_scope_notes: src/classify/featdefs.cpp:183 reads tfscanf %s into char ShortName[80] (FEAT_NAME_SIZE, src/classify/ocrfeatures.h:32) from training .tr feature files; different input and different sink.
src/training/common/commontraining.cpp:349 reads sscanf %*s %s from a 2048-byte line into char unichar[UNICHAR_LEN+1]; training tools only.
src/training/common/mastertrainer.cpp:488,501 read tfscanf %s into char uch[UNICHAR_LEN] / kerned_uch[UNICHAR_LEN] from font spacing files; training tools only.
src/classify/cutoffs.cpp:69 ASSERT_HOST aborts on an unknown class in pffmtable; abort-type DoS, not this sink.
